description: Well 42-003-37626 oil production is zero from 2022-05 onward. Last 12 months (holdout) are all zeros, so MAPE cannot be computed. Well is effectively dead for oil — started 1995-06 at ~4300 bbl/month, declined conventionally to ~1100 by 2003, went erratic 2007-2011, had possible restim 2011-07 (1699 bbl), then crashed to near-zero by 2014. Cannot optimize DCA parameters with current hindcast framework.
